title: iOS Maintenance
meta: A starter sprint of updates, compatibility fixes and improvements to keep your iPhone app running well. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: iOS maintenance, starting with a first care sprint
overview: New iOS versions and Xcode updates can quietly break an app. We start with a fixed sprint: we build your app on the latest tools, fix warnings and crashes, update outdated libraries and test on current devices. You get a written report and a clean build ready for the App Store. If you want regular care after that, we quote monthly support separately.

pkgs.blurb: A health check and the most urgent fixes.
Compatibility updates, library upgrades and a tested release build.
A full sprint with performance and privacy checks and a care plan.

faq: No. It is a fixed sprint with a start and an end. Monthly care, including regular updates and response times, is quoted separately once we see how much your app needs.
What if the app uses old libraries that are no longer supported?
We list them, upgrade what is safe and suggest replacements for the rest. Replacing a deep dependency can be a bigger job, so we price it separately before doing it.
Will you publish the update for me?
We prepare the build and release notes. With limited access to your App Store Connect, we can upload it, and the submission happens in your account. Your keys and passwords stay with you.
Can you fix bugs that users report?
Yes, within the numbers in your package. Send the reports or screenshots and we sort them by impact. Bugs that need large changes are listed with a price instead.
